message.content:
A magazine cover features two men shaking hands in a barren landscape filled with tree stumps and swirling white vapor. One man on the left, seen from behind, wears a black suit and holds a silver briefcase. The other man, facing slightly left, wears a light-colored utility jacket and green trousers. They stand centrally on an orange-brown ground. Numerous dark grey tree stumps with jagged bases are scattered across the scene. Translucent white wisps of smoke or vapor weave between the stumps.

The top of the cover displays the white logo "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. At the upper left, text reads "Panas-Dingin Mega-Prabowo H.28". At the upper right, text reads "Gerbong Tentara ke Perusahaan Negara H.100". The central white text reads "MAIN MATA DENDA SAWIT", followed by a paragraph in smaller white font beginning with "Kejaksaan Agung menyidik dugaan permainan..." and ending with "H.86". A white barcode, QR code, and publication details including "3-9 MARET 2025" and "RP 60.000" are at the bottom left. A red rectangle occupies the top left corner.
